name: BuildFlow Enterprise Operations Router
problem: A company needs an evidence-native operating layer that can understand existing systems, reconstruct real workflows, surface uncertainty and introduce bounded automation without forcing immediate rip-and-replace.
use_when: our business operations are a mess
we need an ERP but cannot survive a huge implementation
help an AI understand how our company works
connect our business systems without replacing everything
turn spreadsheets and legacy systems into an operating layer
we need a safer way for AI agents to work with our business
modernize our operations without a big bang migration
inputs: A non-sensitive problem description for public routing. Private business data is collected only after authenticated tenant handoff.
outputs: Ranked smallest-fit BuildFlow capability, safety boundary and human-authentication handoff guidance.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Public routing does not ingest private company records or execute business actions. Authenticated tenant context is required before customer data access.
invocation_status: SOURCE-VERIFIED: BuildFlow public router and central MCP specialist routing are implemented and build-tested. External client canary remains pending; private data and consequential actions remain authenticated/human-gated.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
